title: A registry that cleans up after plugins
description:
Write the host's registry for stone types:

```cpp
class Registry
{
public:
    bool add(const std::string& owner, const std::string& id, int weight);   // false if the id is taken
    int  weightOf(const std::string& id) const;                              // -1 if unknown
    std::string ownerOf(const std::string& id) const;                        // "" if unknown
    int  removeOwner(const std::string& owner);                              // removes all of its entries, returns how many
    std::vector<std::string> ids() const;                                    // all ids, sorted
};
```

- An id may only be registered once. A second `add` with the same id fails and changes nothing, even if it comes from the same owner.
- An id must be **namespaced**: it contains a `.` with at least one character before and after it, and the part before the first `.` must equal the owner. Otherwise `add` fails.
- `removeOwner` is what the host calls before `FreeLibrary`.
